description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 2 with a chance to lower a random stat as well.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 2 with a chance to lower a random stat as well.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，全场都会受到2点伤害，而且有几率随机令1项属性降低。

description: 2-4 aliens spawn in each battle. Aliens are invading!
desc_texts_en: 2-4 aliens spawn in each battle. Aliens are invading!
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现2到4个外星人。外星人来侵略啦！

description: A few bramble patches spawn in each battle, but something is strange about them...
desc_texts_en: A few bramble patches spawn in each battle, but something is strange about them...
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗会出现几片灌木，只是看起来不太对劲……

description: 1-2 extra birds spawn in each battle.
desc_texts_en: 1-2 extra birds spawn in each battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗会额外出现1到2只鸟。

description: 2-4 birds spawn in each battle. All birds are stronger, and angry!
desc_texts_en: 2-4 birds spawn in each battle. All birds are stronger, and angry!
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗会出现2到4个鸟。鸟类全部变强，也更加暴躁！

description: All units have +3 Health Regen. Persistent Holy Element.
desc_texts_en: All units have +3 Health Regen. Persistent Holy Element.
desc_texts_zh: 所有单位的生命自然恢复+3。场上持续出现神圣元素。

description: Persistent Ice Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Ice Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.
desc_texts_zh: 场上持续出现冰元素。每轮结束时，风会把所有东西随机吹动1格。每个回合结束后，有几率落下闪电，随机劈中1个方格。

description: A random unit in each battle has a bounty. A Bounty Hunter is here to collect.
desc_texts_en: A random unit in each battle has a bounty. A Bounty Hunter is here to collect.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会随机有1个单位被悬赏。赏金猎手来领赏金了。

description: All allies have +2 luck.
desc_texts_en: All allies have +2 luck.
desc_texts_zh: 友方全体运气+2。

description: All units have a 25% chance to start each battle with Fear or Poison.
desc_texts_en: All units have a 25% chance to start each battle with Fear or Poison.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗开始时，所有单位都有25%的几率【害怕】或【中毒】。

description: The weather around here is crazy! It's different every battle!
desc_texts_en: The weather around here is crazy! It's different every battle!
desc_texts_zh: 这边天气太离谱了！每场战斗都不一样！

description: There is extra catnip in every battle. Find a random pill after every battle.
desc_texts_en: There is extra catnip in every battle. Find a random pill after every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会额外出现一些猫薄荷。每场战斗结束后，都会随机发现1粒胶囊。

description: There was an earthquake! Objects in each battle have been destroyed and there are rocks everywhere!
desc_texts_en: There was an earthquake! Objects in each battle have been destroyed and there are rocks everywhere!
desc_texts_zh: 地震了！每场战斗的物体都已经毁坏，地上到处是石头！

description: A mini volcano spawns in each battle.
desc_texts_en: A mini volcano spawns in each battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现1座迷你火山。

description: All allies have +2 luck.
desc_texts_en: All allies have +2 luck.
desc_texts_zh: 友方全体运气+2。

description: Persistent Fire Element. Fires no longer burn out. Parts of the map are on fire.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Fire Element. Fires no longer burn out. Parts of the map are on fire.
desc_texts_zh: 场上持续出现火元素，火势不会自行熄灭。地图上有些地方着火了。

description: Persistent Water Element. There are a ton of extra water tiles in every battle.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Water Element. There are a ton of extra water tiles in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 场上持续出现水元素。每场战斗都会出现大量额外的水方格。

description: At the end of each turn, there's a chance to get bitten for 1 damage and 1 Bleed.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each turn, there's a chance to get bitten for 1 damage and 1 Bleed.
desc_texts_zh: 每个回合结束时，都有几率被叮，受到1点伤害，获得1层【出血】。

description: All attacks and abilities have a +10% chance to miss.
desc_texts_en: All attacks and abilities have a +10% chance to miss.
desc_texts_zh: 所有攻击和能力落空的几率+10%。

description: All rocks levitate at the end of the round. Extra rocks spawn in each battle.
desc_texts_en: All rocks levitate at the end of the round. Extra rocks spawn in each battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，石头都会漂起来。每场战斗还会出现额外的石头。

description: 2-4 ghosts spawn in each battle. All ghosts have gone rogue!
desc_texts_en: 2-4 ghosts spawn in each battle. All ghosts have gone rogue!
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗会出现2到4个鬼魂。所有鬼魂都失控啦！

description: Cats do not heal after battle. All heals are reduced by 1. Can be mitigated with water.
desc_texts_en: Cats do not heal after battle. All heals are reduced by 1. Can be mitigated with water.
desc_texts_zh: 战斗结束后，猫不会恢复生命。所有治疗/恢复效果减1。可以用水缓解。

description: Persistent Water Element. There are extra water tiles in every battle.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Water Element. There are extra water tiles in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 持续出现水元素。每场战斗都会出现额外的水方格。

description: There are extra bear traps in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There are extra bear traps in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的捕兽夹。

description: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 10 spaces in a random direction.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 10 spaces in a random direction.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，风会把所有东西随机吹动10格。

description: All non-tiny units explode into a charmed maggot when they die.
desc_texts_en: All non-tiny units explode into a charmed maggot when they die.
desc_texts_zh: 只要不是微型单位，死亡时都会爆炸，产生1个【洗脑】的蛆。

description: Some tiles will get Raptured at the end of each round during the battle. More tiles are affected every round.
desc_texts_en: Some tiles will get Raptured at the end of each round during the battle. More tiles are affected every round.
desc_texts_zh: 战斗期间，每轮结束时都会有一些方格被提上天。每轮被提走的方格都会增多。

description: Persistent Fire Element. Fireballs occasionally rain down from the sky. Fires no longer burn out.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Fire Element. Fireballs occasionally rain down from the sky. Fires no longer burn out.
desc_texts_zh: 场上持续出现火元素。天上偶尔落下火球。火势不会自行熄灭。

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，全场都会受到1点伤害，同时有33%的几率造成【瘀伤】。

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，全场都会受到1点伤害，同时有33%的几率造成【瘀伤】。

description: Jumps, throws, and projectile abilities have +2 range. All physical abilities have +1 Knockback. Other abilities that cause Knockback have +1 Knockback as well.
desc_texts_en: Jumps, throws, and projectile abilities have +2 range. All physical abilities have +1 Knockback. Other abilities that cause Knockback have +1 Knockback as well.
desc_texts_zh: 跳跃、抛投和投射类能力的范围+2。所有物理能力的击退距离+1。其他会击退的能力击退距离也+1。

description: After each turn there's a chance for a flaming meteor to fall onto a random tile.
desc_texts_en: After each turn there's a chance for a flaming meteor to fall onto a random tile.
desc_texts_zh: 每个回合结束后，都有几率落下燃烧的流星，随机砸中1个方格。

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1 with a 33% chance to Bruise.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，全场都会受到1点伤害，同时有33%的几率造成【瘀伤】。

description: There are extra land mines in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There are extra land mines in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的地雷。

description: There are no weather effects.
desc_texts_en: There are no weather effects.
desc_texts_zh: 没有天气效果。

description: A puddle of tar appears in each battle.
desc_texts_en: A puddle of tar appears in each battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现一滩焦油。

description: There are extra tall grass and bramble tiles in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There are extra tall grass and bramble tiles in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的草丛方格和灌木方格。

description: All units have a 25% chance to have Madness each round.
desc_texts_en: All units have a 25% chance to have Madness each round.
desc_texts_zh: 所有单位每轮都有25%的几率【癫狂】。

description: There are extra coins in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There are extra coins in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的硬币。

description: There is extra poop and sewage in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There is extra poop and sewage in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的大便和污水。

description: Persistent Water Element.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Water Element.
desc_texts_zh: 持续出现水元素。

description: There are extra neutral frogs in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There are extra neutral frogs in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的中立青蛙。

description: Zombies spawn at the end of each round.
desc_texts_en: Zombies spawn at the end of each round.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时会出现僵尸。

description: 2-4 robots spawn in each battle. All robots have gone rogue!
desc_texts_en: 2-4 robots spawn in each battle. All robots have gone rogue!
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗会出现2到4个机器人。机器人全都失控啦！

description: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, damages everything by 1.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，全场都会受到1点伤害。

description: Persistent Ice Element.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Ice Element.
desc_texts_zh: 持续出现冰元素。

description: A solar flare strikes a large area at the end of each round, Burning and inflicting Blind.
desc_texts_en: A solar flare strikes a large area at the end of each round, Burning and inflicting Blind.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，太阳耀斑会打击一大片区域，造成【灼烧】和【瞎眼】。

description: All units gain Stealth at the start of the battle.
desc_texts_en: All units gain Stealth at the start of the battle.
desc_texts_zh: 战斗开始时，所有单位获得【隐匿】。

description: 3-6 strange eggs spawn in each battle. Kill them before they hatch!
desc_texts_en: 3-6 strange eggs spawn in each battle. Kill them before they hatch!
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗会出现3到6颗奇怪的蛋。趁着还没孵出来，快把它们打烂！

description: At the end of the round, all units gain +1 Thorns.
desc_texts_en: At the end of the round, all units gain +1 Thorns.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，所有单位【尖刺】+1。

description: At the end of the round, each corpse has a 25% chance to revive at half health with Madness 5.
desc_texts_en: At the end of the round, each corpse has a 25% chance to revive at half health with Madness 5.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，每具尸体都有25%的几率以一半的生命复活，同时获得5层【癫狂】。

description: All units gain a random status effect at the start of each round. Cats gain a random mutation at the end of each battle.
desc_texts_en: All units gain a random status effect at the start of each round. Cats gain a random mutation at the end of each battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮开始时，所有单位随机获得1个状态效果。每场战斗结束时，猫会随机获得1项突变。

description: Persistent Water Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.
desc_texts_en: Persistent Water Element. At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction. After each turn, there's a chance for a random lightning strike.
desc_texts_zh: 场上持续出现水元素。每轮结束时，风会把所有东西随机吹动1格。每个回合结束后，都有几率落下闪电，随机劈中1个方格。

description: Twisters spawn each round.
desc_texts_en: Twisters spawn each round.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮都会出现龙卷风。

description: A punching bag with Kinetic Spikes 5 spawns in each battle.
desc_texts_en: A punching bag with Kinetic Spikes 5 spawns in each battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现1个带5层【动能尖刺】的受气包。

description: There is extra junk in every battle.
desc_texts_en: There is extra junk in every battle.
desc_texts_zh: 每场战斗都会出现额外的垃圾。

description: There's lots of flies!
desc_texts_en: There's lots of flies!
desc_texts_zh: 到处都是苍蝇！

description: There is fire everywhere!
desc_texts_en: There is fire everywhere!
desc_texts_zh: 大火烧得到处都是！

description: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction.
desc_texts_en: At the end of each round, wind blows everything 1 space in a random direction.
desc_texts_zh: 每轮结束时，风会把所有东西随机吹动1格。
